purpose: Add independent Boomr and Footsteppr inverse experts after their Transfxr recreations failed human adequacy; keep older experts available.

data.sampling: existing 50% native / 30% sparse / 20% broad global mutations
data.split: Parameter-hash grouped original split, then reserve all 16 selected native control groups per engine from validation too, in separate fit-data views. Exact numeric/categorical controls are also checked for overlap ignoring randomness codes.

training.selection: minimum per-engine validation control loss; not evaluation audio scores

evaluation.input: exact peak-normalized PCM16 reference given to each new expert
evaluation.selection: minimum actual-audition matching distance; no source-engine label or pitch guard
evaluation.historicalBaseline: retained Transfxr mixture pool rescored on the same audition reference; also preserve exact historical human winners for listening
evaluation.freshBaseline: four Transfxr mixture proposals from the same PCM16 reference
evaluation.claims: Changing capacity and adding source synths, not a matched architecture ablation. Self-inversion and cross-engine transfer reported separately. No success claim from distance alone.
evaluation.nativeHoldout: No optimization or checkpoint-selection validation exposure. Same preset families as training; not a preset-family holdout.

listening.include: native controls, cross-engine examples, tagged real reference, and metric agreement/disagreement cases where distinct plausible outputs exist
listening.candidateGeneration: no human adjudication fabricated or inferred from metrics

preTrainingAmendments: Boomr generation moved from one worker to four independently seeded parts after observing rendering cost. Total rows unchanged; merge regroups all exact controls before splitting. The interrupted single-worker manifest remains incomplete and is not training input. No model trained or evaluation score inspected before this change.

Before fitting, strengthen the 32 native references into a true test split by excluding their entire control groups from checkpoint-selection validation as well. Original generated data remains unchanged; the training script creates separately bound fit-data views. No model or evaluation scores yet.
